title: Get a TIN - Uganda Revenue Authority

| 2 | Minor | A copy of the Legal/Court document of guardianship |
| 3 | Non-Citizens of Uganda | ·         Passport ( Mandatory ) ·         Visa ·         Work permit(M) ·         Refugee ID (M for refugees) |
| 4 | Diplomats | ·         Diplomatic Foreign Affairs ID ·         Letter from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs In addition to non-citizen requirements |
| 5 | Business Name | Business Name Registration Certificate (in case of a sole proprietorship) In addition to individual identification documents |

| SN | Sub-entity type | Documents required (M- Mandatory, O- Optional) |  |

| 5 | Local Authority | ·         City Council ·         City Division Council ·         District Council ·         Municipal Council ·         Municipal Division ·         Council ·         Sub County Council ·         Town Council | Act of Parliament (M) Statutory Instrument(M) |

| Estate or Trust | Certificate of registration (M) Trust deed (O) |  |  |
| NGO | NGO Certificate (M) Constitution Certificate of Registration (O) |  |  |
